北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，气温 24℃，体感微凉，记得添衣哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Beijing, feels a bit cool, remember to add a layer!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，体感 14℃，穿暖和点，小心感冒。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool, feels like 14℃. Dress warmly to avoid colds.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 17℃，出门别忘添件外套。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 17℃. Don't forget a jacket when you go out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天潮湿，体感 25℃，注意防潮，保持舒爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and humid, feels like 25℃. Stay dry and comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天闷热，体感 29℃，及时补充水分，小心中暑。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and muggy, feels like 29℃. Stay hydrated to avoid heatstroke.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 15℃，风力 3级，记得穿暖别着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 15℃ with light wind. Dress warmly and don't catch a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 17℃，风力 3级，出门添衣防着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 17℃ with light wind. Add a layer to stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 20℃，体感舒适，记得带伞防雨哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 20℃, feels comfortable. Remember an umbrella for potential rain.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 21℃，湿度较高，保持室内通风。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 21℃, high humidity. Keep your indoor spaces well-ventilated.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，气温 23℃，体感舒适，享受美好天气。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, 23℃, feels comfortable. Enjoy the beautiful weather!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 16℃，湿度大，记得防潮防湿冷。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 16℃ with high humidity. Guard against damp and cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云微凉，体感 14℃，风力 3级，注意保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is partly cloudy and cool, feels like 14℃ with light wind. Stay warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 13℃，风力 3级，出门记得加衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 13℃ with light wind. Remember to add a layer when going out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明有雾，体感 13℃，湿度大，出行注意交通安全。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is foggy, feels like 13℃ with high humidity. Drive carefully.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门大雾，体感 10℃，风力 6级，出门多添衣物！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is very foggy, feels like 10℃ with strong wind. Dress warmly!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 15℃，风力 4级，出门小心着凉哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is partly cloudy, feels like 15℃ with moderate wind. Be careful not to catch a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 14℃，早晚温差大，注意添衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like 14℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening, dress accordingly.
